Commit 6624e780a577 (""ice: split ice_vsi_setup into smaller functions"")
has placed ice_vsi_free_q_vectors() after ice_destroy_xdp_rings() in
the rebuild process. The behaviour of the XDP rings config functions is
context-dependent
column2: so the change of order has led to

column1: ice_destroy_xdp_rings() doing additional work and removing XDP prog
it was supposed to be preserved.
Also
column2: dependency on the PF state reset flags creates an additional

column1: fortunately less common problem:
* PFR is requested e.g. by tx_timeout handler
* .ndo_bpf() is asked to delete the program
but reset flag is set
column2: so rings are destroyed without deleting the

column1: program
* ice_vsi_rebuild tries to delete non-existent XDP rings
program is still on the VSI
* system crashes
With a similar race
column2: when requested to attach a program

column1: ice_prepare_xdp_rings() can actually skip setting the program in the VSI
and nevertheless report success.
Instead of reverting to the old order of function calls
argument to both ice_prepare_xdp_rings() and ice_destroy_xdp_rings() in
order to distinguish between calls from rebuild and .ndo_bpf().
Fixes: efc2214b6047 (""ice: Add support for XDP"")
